payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcome.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

check.question: Is the mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
check.complete_when: A clearly identifiable mug is positioned to the right of the headphones, regardless of whether another mug-like object remains elsewhere.
check.partial_when: The edited image shows a mug moved toward the right of the headphones, but its position is not clearly to their right.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no mug has been moved toward or placed to the right of the headphones.
check.unknown_when: The mug, headphones, or their relative positions cannot be determined confidently.

dependencies.evidence: Both objects are identifiable in the edited image: the headphones are near the center and the mug is clearly to their right, so their relative positions can be compared.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image shows a clearly identifiable mug on the right side of the headphones. Another mug-like object remains to their left, which does not negate the requested placement."}

parsed.evidence: The edited image shows a clearly identifiable mug on the right side of the headphones. Another mug-like object remains to their left, which does not negate the requested placement.
